description: Verifies that adding or modifying an amount does not cause the sum of existing amounts for a period/category to exceed a defined budget or quota limit. Raises BudgetExceededException on violation.
required_invariants: Amount addition must not exceed monthly budget limit

description: Checks if the number of active associations (e.g. active borrowed books, bottles in a storage location, pending orders) does not exceed the maximum allowed capacity. Raises QuotaExceededException or OverCapacityException.
required_invariants: Active count must not exceed entity maximum capacity

description: Verifies that sufficient inventory/stock quantity exists before fulfilling an order, decrementing stock, or loaning a resource. Raises InsufficientStockException.
required_invariants: Available copies/stock cannot drop below zero
template_logic:
item = repo.get_by_id(item_id)
if item.available_quantity < requested_qty:
    raise InsufficientStockException(f'Requested {requested_qty} but only {item.available_quantity} available')
item.available_quantity -= requested_qty
repo.update(item)

description: Validates pricing rules (e.g. selling price must be strictly greater than cost price, discount percentage between 0 and 100). Raises InvalidPricingException.
required_invariants: Selling price must be strictly greater than cost price
template_logic:
if selling_price <= cost_price:
    raise InvalidPricingException('Selling price must be strictly greater than cost price')

description: Enforces valid state lifecycle transitions (e.g. pending -> confirmed -> shipped, active -> inactive, borrowed -> returned). Raises InvalidStateTransitionException.
required_invariants: Invalid state transitions must be rejected
template_logic:
if current_status not in allowed_previous_states:
    raise InvalidStateTransitionException(f'Cannot transition from {current_status} to {new_status}')
